comment: Dependency vulnerability policy enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs (see docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md).

severityPolicy.comment: prod findings are enforced at or above blockAtOrAboveProd; dev findings are only *reported* unless they reach blockAtOrAboveAnyScope. This deliberately keeps the build green for genuinely unpatchable dev-tool advisories while making them visible in the CI job summary.

Tracked in docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md; remove once upstream publishes a fix or Storybook drops the polyfill chain.
